source: SPM Essay (older format, no trial paper named) · Essay on spending and online safety
paragraphs: Online shopping has become a convenient way for people to buy things, but it also comes with risks. Many people fall victim to online scams, where they are tricked into giving away their personal information or money. It is important to be aware of these dangers and take steps to protect ourselves when spending money online.

One common way people get tricked online is through fake websites or advertisements. Scammers create websites that look like real online stores, but they steal money or personal details instead of delivering products. Phishing emails are another trick, where scammers pretend to be trusted companies and ask for sensitive information. Some people also fall for deals that seem too good to be true, only to realize later that they have been scammed.

To protect yourself when shopping online, it’s essential to use trusted websites and always check the URL for security features, such as “https” and a padlock symbol. Avoid clicking on links from unknown emails or messages, and never share personal or financial information on unverified sites. It is also helpful to read customer reviews and research sellers before making any purchase. Using secure payment methods, like credit cards or PayPal, can also provide extra protection in case something goes wrong.

To spread awareness about online safety among teenagers, schools and parents can teach them about the risks of online shopping and scams. Organizing workshops on digital literacy and creating educational content about safe online practices can help. Teenagers should also be encouraged to ask for advice from trusted adults before making online purchases.

In conclusion, while online shopping offers convenience, it is important to be cautious to avoid falling into scams. By staying informed and taking protective measures, we can shop safely and help others become more aware of online risks.
